what_was_kept: Every request's result.json, which carries the whole per-step trace. Raw per-tick ledgers and compiled scenes for a declared subset only.
why: The ledgers are 8.1 GB and only a handful can ever be rendered. Keeping all of them would make the working tree unusable for no gain.
how_to_get_a_removed_ledger_back: .deps/cable-venv/Scripts/pythonw.exe scripts/evaluate_cable_routing_v6.py --run-dir artifacts/cable/routing-v6-s1 --config artifacts/cable/routing-v6-s1__runtime.json --case <request id>. The seeds are registered, so the re-run reproduces the request exactly.
selection_rule: Matched triples: every (group, error level) under all three supervisors, at the rigid mount, nominal offset, first draw. A side-by-side replay needs the same cell under three rules.
One example of every distinct failure reason under every supervisor.
